children: Nova Minerals announced Port MacKenzie Industry Day spotlighting its antimony processing and refining project backed by a US$43.4 million U.S. Department of War award.
Nearly 100 industry, government and infrastructure leaders attended Port MacKenzie Industry Day to discuss development plans.
Nova Minerals’ antimony processing and refining project identified as an anchor tenant for the Port MacKenzie industrial district.
Project is supported by a US$43.4 million award from the U.S. Department of War to help establish a domestic antimony supply chain.
Port MacKenzie offers ~10,000 acres of industrial-zoned land with multimodal transport, positioning it as a gateway for mineral exports.
Stakeholders discussed infrastructure projects (West Susitna Access Road, rail extension, Alaska LNG) to support industrial growth and supply chains.
